text.text: Little two offers such great food for a great price! Their food is fresh, super tasty, good portions, and a very healthy option. I found it very easy to share my meal with my toddler as their food is not oily. Safe to say my baby enjoyed the food too as she continued asking for more saying:  “還要”. 😂👌🏻🤍 Also, they offer comfy baby high chairs making it easy for you to eat with little ones. The owners are also really friendly and will make you feel welcomed. Thank you Uncle and Auntie! We are definitely coming back!

text.text: Perfect spot for solo hotpot! The setup is great for single diners, and the fish was the highlight—super fresh, tender, and full of flavor, especially in the spicy broth. Cozy atmosphere and great service make it a must-visit for seafood lovers.

【N訪】這間簡餐好吃又乾淨，因為簡餐是現點現做，所以老闆有提醒出餐會稍慢，但感覺的出來做菜很用心，每種套餐都很好吃

「蔥爆松阪豬」$340
炒過之後的松阪豬更下飯了

「椒鹽松阪豬」$340
松阪豬切滿一整盤，誠意十足

「蒜泥白肉」$290
滿滿一整盤肉，直接吃爽了

「麻油雞」$350
這道味道普通，較不推薦

「蔥爆蒜香牛排」$350
這道菜簡直就是配飯神器，根本停不下來

「義式雞腿排」$300
非常貼心去骨的雞腿排，不怕你吃就怕你沒吃飽

飲料是冰紅茶都可以無限續杯，而且餐點全部都不額外加收服務費，是會讓人一直想回訪的店😄
